title: KCP relation_retract result (DESIGN.md §10.2, §11.6.1 space/content mutation family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for relation_retract (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). The appended RelationDisposition projection, kind retract (gap notes KG4/KG22).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

kind.description: RelationDisposition.kind is the closed single-value retract (§10.2); retraction never deletes or rewrites the assertion or its provenance (§10.2).

reason_class.description: Disposition reason class token; no value space is pinned (gap note KG22).

relationDisposition.description: RelationDisposition projection, field names verbatim from the §10.2 record shape (gap notes KG4/KG22).

statusToken.description: Bounded lowercase token for a field DESIGN.md names without pinning a value space; pins the shape without inventing an enum (gap note KG6).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
